Select distinct compound ChEMBL IDs and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against the target 'Histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2A' in human assays. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno (INNER JOIN). Filter target_dictionary.pref_name to 'Histone-lysine N-methyltransferase 2A' and assays.assay_organism to 'Homo sapiens'. Return columns: molecule_dictionary.chembl_id aliased as compound_chembl_id, compound_structures.canonical_smiles. Sort by compound_chembl_id.
